paragraphs: Mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 1:3, where he said that Shemaya was also one of Moses’ names.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ויק״ר פ״א־ג is read as Vayikra Rabbah chapter 1 section 3, without independent named-edition verification.

אף שמעיה שמו means Shemaya too was his name; the source parenthesis של משה identifies Moses. The English integrates that source clarification rather than inventing it. The speaker is understood from the heading, and his abbreviated title remains R'.
